review_method.source_comparison: Compared the source image with decoded frames 0, 75, and 147 and a one-frame-per-second contact sheet.
review_method.technical_verification: Re-ran scripts/segmind_wan22_case14.py verify, including ffprobe -count_frames and receipt digest checks.

observations.requested_motion: The lower-center pearl earrings move, but the motion is dominated by rotation of the whole earring hardware rather than a compact pendulum-only sway of the pearls.
invariant_failures: The upper-center jewelry pair rotates and changes apparent geometry even though it was required to remain still.
Additional earrings outside the lower-center target animate or change orientation.
The lower-center metal mounts rotate and change position instead of preserving exact product geometry.
stable_elements: The overall collage layout remains recognizable.
The two fashion portraits and clothing remain substantially more stable than the jewelry.

verdict.summary: Eliza -> Segmind Wan 2.2 Flash is operational, fast, inexpensive, and returns a clean silent 720p MP4, but this case does not preserve non-target jewelry or exact product geometry well enough for unattended PromoPages generation.

limitations: The image and prompt are sent to an external hosted Segmind API.
The route is synchronous and non-idempotent; a retry can incur a second charge.
This result covers one case and cannot establish aggregate quality or reliability.
No second paid generation was performed to test prompt or seed sensitivity.
